arithmetic: integer, Boolean and finite-set operations; no floating point

scope.colored_dp: all color maps with p=min(k,n)-1 on the exhaustive instances for 2<=k<=n; independent simple-path oracle
scope.exhaustive_original_instances: all labelled simple undirected graphs on 1..3 vertices, all deletion maps, all ordered endpoints, k=1..n+1
scope.padding: m=1..7, p=1..4, mu=1..4, all admissible disjoint actual-edge pairs
scope.seeded: 500 instances on 4..7 vertices, at most 9 edges
scope.vertex_cover: all labelled simple undirected graphs on 1..5 vertices and all simple paths
